summary: Frontend-only e2e test of the static MMSI V3.8 Code Auditor (single-file vanilla JS app served at preview root). All 7 requested behaviours verified: import view loads (light theme, no overlap), file picker (multi-file, non-directory input) accepts set_input_files, progress view+bar appears, results view shows 8 critical findings for vulnerable.js containing eval/innerHTML/document.write/hardcoded secret/prototype pollution/path traversal with German recommendations and NICHT-BESTANDEN certificate, clean.js produces 'Zero-Defect zertifiziert' verdict, empty 'Keine Befunde — sauber!' state, and ZERO-DEFECT certificate. Export & certificate downloads both fire (mmsi-audit-bericht.txt, mmsi-zertifikat.txt). 'Neues Audit' returns to import view. No console errors and no page errors during the whole flow.
critical_code_review_comments: Single-file HTML app is duplicated between /app/src/assets/code_auditor.html and /app/src/assets/index.html — any future edit must update both files or one should become a symlink/generated copy to avoid drift.

The 'MMSI V3.8 Code Auditor bereit' startup console log could not be captured by the Playwright listener (likely fires before listener attaches on this static page). Not a defect, just a note for future regression on the 'no console errors' assertion — errors were correctly zero.
seed_data_creation: Created /tmp/vulnerable.js (with eval, innerHTML, document.write, hardcoded password, __proto__, path traversal, nested if/for) and /tmp/clean.js (safe add/sub) as inputs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is static (python http.server on 3000 -> ingress). Test at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL root. Upload files via set_input_files on [data-testid=file-input] (multi-file, non-directory). Allow ~2-3s after upload for progress animation (~140ms/file + 450ms) before asserting [data-testid=view-results]. All data-testids listed in the request are present and functional.
rca of the issue: n/a — no bugs found. Previous fatal script-parse error and dark/overlapping UI are gone; rebuild is clean.
